Physician Selection
Instructions
To select a Provider ID # and Primary Care ID, click on “Provider Lookup”
below and follow the prompts to find a provider.
Locate the Provider ID # and the Primary Care ID and place it in the corresponding fields below.
If you are unable to find the Provider ID # and the Primary Care ID that you are searching for,
please provide the Provider’s first and last name in the fields below.
If you do not complete the Provider ID # AND Primary Care ID, a Primary Care provider will be
selected for you by the Plan.
If you/your prospect is already seeing the provider being listed, please be sure to complete the
field below with a Yes. Otherwise, answer No.

NOTE 2: Accuracy in these provider fields is vitally important to ensure the Primary Care provider
selected reflects you/your prospectschoice and not one assigned by the Plan.
